HOW TO USE

Training a LoRA needs a caption for every picture: a .txt file with the same name, next to it. This workflow looks at every picture in a folder and writes those captions for you, in one Run. You get a ready Training Set folder: 01_Cat.png + 01_Cat.txt, 02_Dog.png + 02_Dog.txt, and so on.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Portraits inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Your trigger word

  • Type your trigger word in the FIRST box of Text Join Two Pixaroma, like pixa_style. Every caption then starts with it.
  • Leave it empty if your trainer does not use a trigger word.

 Change how the captions are written

  • The instruction is the formula, in the gear of AI Prompt Pixaroma. Ask for shorter captions, tags with commas, or to leave out things that are the same in every picture (that is what the trigger word stands for).
  • Read the captions in the Save Text Pixaroma box after the Run, and fix any you do not like in the .txt files themselves.

 Run it again into an EMPTY Training Set folder (move or rename the old one first). The captions are REPLACED, but Save Image never replaces a picture: a second Run adds 01_Cat_001.png, a copy with no caption of its own.

 Save Text and Save Image change a file name the same way when it has characters a file cannot keep (a name starting with _, for example), so the picture and its caption always stay a pair here.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved What AI Prompt needs Nodes look different from the video

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 8B, looks at the pictures) - Qwen3-VL 8B, a language model that can SEE. It looks at each picture and writes what it sees. It runs on your own PC, nothing is sent online.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your training pictures) - Point it at the folder of pictures you want to train on and pick them. Press Run once and it sends every picture through, one after the other. Its filename output names the caption and the copy, so 01_Cat.png gets 01_Cat.txt.
  • AI Prompt Pixaroma (2. writes one caption per picture) - Shows each picture to Qwen3-VL with the instruction in its formula (the gear): write a 25 to 50 word caption of what is in the picture. The picture comes in on the image wire, the model on the clip wire.
  • Text Join Two Pixaroma (3. your trigger word in front) - Puts your trigger word in front of every caption, with a comma, like pixa_style, a ginger cat.... Type it in the FIRST box. Leave it empty for captions with no trigger word.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Text Pixaroma (one .txt per picture, same name) - One file per entry is on (the gear): every caption is saved as its own .txt in ComfyUI/output/Training Set, named like its picture. The box on the node shows all of them together, so you can read them in one place.
  • Save Image Pixaroma (a copy of each picture, same name) - Saves a PNG copy of each picture into the same Training Set folder, with the same name as its caption. Picture and caption side by side is what LoRA trainers want.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
Loading Qwen3-VL the first timeabout 2 s more
Each captionabout 2 to 4 s
4 pictures (the demo)about 10 s

Qwen3-VL 8B needs about 10 GB of video memory. On a smaller card ComfyUI moves part of it to the computer's memory: it still works, slower.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a 16 GB card

Timed on an RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB with 32 GB of RAM:

  • The AI text step took about 2 times as long.
